inlines.v: AF'AR, adverb [a and far. See Far.] 1. At a distance in place; to or from a distance; used with from preceding, or off following; as, he was seen from afar; I saw him afar off. 2. In scripture, figuratively, estranged in affection; alienated. My kinsmen stand afar off. Psalms 38:11. 3. Absent; not assisting. Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? Psalms 10:1 4. Not of the visible church. Ephesians 2:17.
